details:
The Boy Who Dreamed of Mars

Our Project

1. Project Summary

The Boy Who Dreamed of Mars is an educational Visual Novel that takes players on an adventure to a Martian colony. Through an interesting story, Egyptian cultural touches, and interactive mini-games, we want to make learning more exciting and meaningful for children.

The game is not just about space or completing missions. It is about learning how to think, make difficult decisions, and deal with unexpected problems. Along the way, players will discover basic space science, learn about the challenges astronauts face, and experience important values such as humility, teamwork, and perseverance.

2. Why Did We Create This Game?

Video games are a big part of many children's lives. They can be entertaining, but we believe they can also be a great way to help children learn useful skills.

We wanted to create something that combines both. Instead of simply giving players information, we want them to experience situations where they have to think carefully, choose what to do, and deal with the results of their decisions.

3. The Main Idea

Imagine that you are living in a Martian colony on Day 24 of your mission. Suddenly, a huge dust storm is approaching, threatening to bury the colony's solar panels.

You have only 10 seconds to make a decision:

  • Close the solar panels and lose a large part of your energy temporarily.
  • Leave them open and risk losing much more.

What would you choose?

This is just one example of the situations players will face. Every decision can change what happens next, making the player feel responsible for the colony and its survival.

4. What Will Players Learn?

Decision-making and problem-solving

Players will have to think quickly, understand the situation, consider possible risks, and make decisions under pressure.

Space science

The game introduces basic astronomy and space science using information from reliable sources, including NASA. Players will learn about Mars, space weather, solar storms, and other topics through the story and mini-games.

Life lessons

Throughout the story, players will also discover that making mistakes is part of learning. The characters and their experiences highlight the importance of being humble, working together, taking responsibility, and never giving up when things get difficult.

5. What Makes Our Game Different?

We want players to feel that they are actually part of the story, not just reading information or answering questions.

The mini-games are connected to the events happening in the colony, so learning happens naturally while players try to solve problems. We also include elements of Egyptian culture to give the game its own identity.

6. Our Goal

Our goal is to create a game that children enjoy playing but also remember for what it teaches them.

We want them to leave the game with more than scientific knowledge. We want them to become better at thinking, solving problems, making responsible decisions, and facing challenges with confidence.

Because sometimes, the most important thing a game can teach you is not how to win, but how to make the right decision.
